settings.label: NetEase Quality Override
settings.help: Leave empty to follow the player. Options: standard / higher / exhigh / lossless / hires. Your account must have access to the requested quality.

settings.label: NetEase Sign-in Method
settings.help: Leave empty or use qr for QR sign-in; use web for website sign-in. Sessions are stored in the host's plugin data files, not the system keychain.

settings.label: Spotify Client ID
settings.help: Create an app in Spotify's developer dashboard with the redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:43110/callback and Web API ticked, then paste its Client ID here: your browser opens for you to approve. The app's owner needs Premium.
